summary_en: The study tests AMX-883 alone, and in combination with posaconazole, in adults with acute myeloid leukaemia or high-risk myelodysplastic syndrome. AMX-883 is taken by mouth; how long or how often it is given is not stated. The study measures safety, how the drug moves through the body (pharmacokinetics), and early signs of effect (preliminary efficacy); it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: El estudio prueba AMX-883 solo, y en combinación con posaconazol, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda o síndrome mielodisplásico de alto riesgo. AMX-883 se toma por vía oral; no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio mide la seguridad, cómo se mueve el medicamento en el cuerpo (farmacocinética) y los primeros signos de efecto (eficacia preliminar); es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory AML that failed all available standard therapies, or relapsed or refractory high-risk MDS with 10-19% bone marrow blasts.
Adequate washout from prior therapies and adequate kidney and liver function.
Women who could become pregnant and men must use contraception for at least 120 days after the last dose.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukaemia, or chronic myelogenous leukaemia in blast crisis.
Clinically active leukaemia in the central nervous system.
Immunosuppressive therapy after stem cell transplant, or active graft versus host disease above grade 1.
Another active cancer, or cancer needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Long QT syndrome, or family history of long QT or sudden cardiac death before age 40.
